transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
What finally scared me enough to come in is that I keep thinking it might be a relief if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t tried to hurt myself, but those thoughts keep coming up.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
Yeah. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy sadness in my chest, like I’ve already failed the day before it even starts.
Before this current period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed like this for at least two weeks?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of another time that was like this for that long.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event?
I think so. It’s been about four months, since my aunt came to live with us.
Do these feelings seem mostly about your aunt living with you?
I’m not really sure. It started around then, but I can’t say it’s mostly because of her.
Have your emotions tended to swing intensely for many years, even before this period?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed my emotions swinging intensely over the years.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Yes. I used to look forward to my watercolors, dance class, and walks with the ladies, but lately I just leave everything sitting there. I can’t seem to make myself care.
Have these feelings made it hard for you to keep up with your usual daily activities?
Yes. I’ve stopped going to dance class, the walking group, and my shifts at the food pantry. I get stuck and fall behind on errands, so my husband has had to take over more of them.
Have you been feeling this depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Yes. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy sadness in my chest, like I’ve already failed the day before it even starts.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge a lot lately?
I’m not sure I’d call it anxiety. I’ve mostly just felt down and heavy.
Have you noticed your sleep has changed since this started?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed any clear change in my sleep.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite lately?
I don’t think so. My appetite seems about the same as usual.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed any particular trouble concentrating.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?
Yes. Even after a full night in bed, I still feel worn out. Simple things like making breakfast or carrying laundry take more out of me than they used to.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?
Yes... when I’m tired or get annoyed with my aunt, I start thinking I’m a bad woman. Like I’m bringing shame on my family because I’m not grateful enough.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably more slowly than usual lately?
Yes, I think so. My husband says I move like everything takes extra effort now. Even at the market, I’ll stand there too long before I pick up what I came for.
Do you feel that your sadness is mainly because your aunt came to live with you?
I’m not sure it’s mainly because of that. I mean, it’s been hard having her there, but I can’t really say that’s the reason for the sadness.
Would you say these feelings have caused significant problems in your daily life?
Yes. I’ve stopped going to my dance class, the walking group, and my food-pantry shifts. My husband has been doing more of the errands because I get stuck and fall behind.
Before this current period, was there ever another time in your life when you felt depressed like this nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of another time that was like this for that long.
At any earlier time in your life, did you ever have a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed nearly every day?
I don’t remember another time like this. Lately, though, most mornings I wake up with this heavy sadness in my chest, like I’ve already failed before the day even starts.
